choice_policy: One setting per complete episode: whole_section for even seeds and under_drop for odd seeds. Input generation is setting-independent.

episodes.acceptance_description: accept the first candidate section when the floor cell under the drop is red
accept the first candidate section only when every floor cell is red

input_constraints: Inputs are lawful selected-generator scenes with landing second or bottom, target width at least two, and a decisive off-column floor gap while the floor cell under the blue drop remains red.
lesson_policy: 3 labeled demonstrations followed by 4 distinct queries; each query is checked against the other setting using only the demonstrations.
limitations: Evidence covers two consecutive seeds and the one declared rival per episode. It does not prove uniqueness against undeclared rules or authorize production/catalog integration.

meaning.under_drop: accept the first candidate section when the floor cell under the drop is red
meaning.whole_section: accept the first candidate section only when every floor cell is red

scope: proposed task-local prototype; not a canonical rule change, production API, approval, or training admission
